name: Command Palette UI
description: UI interaction spec for the Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay.

dom.overlay: .palette-overlay (position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:4500; display:flex; justify-content:center; padding-top:15vh; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.3))
dom.palette: .palette (width:520px; max-height:60vh; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden)
structure: input.palette-input (width:100%; padding:10px 14px; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); background:transparent; color:var(--primary); font-size:14px; font-family:Space Mono; outline:none)
.palette-item (padding:6px 14px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; border-bottom:1px solid transparent)

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Show overlay, focus input, load recent files from localStorage, start file index walk if not cached

interactions.name: close
interactions.trigger: Escape key OR overlay background click

interactions.name: search_input
interactions.action: Debounced 150ms fuzzy filter: match allFiles against query (lowercase substring match on filename), prioritize exact prefix matches, cap at 50 results

interactions.name: navigate_results
interactions.action: Move .selected class through results, scroll selected into view. selectedIndex wraps at bounds.

interactions.name: select_file
interactions.action: Add file path to recent files in localStorage (max 10, trim old), call onSelect(filePath), close palette

interactions.name: file_indexing
interactions.action: Recursive directory walk via IPC fs:readDir. Threaded: process in chunks with setTimeout yields to avoid blocking. Progress bar updates (width: 0% → 100%). Respects .gitignore paths (skips .git, node_modules).

states.opened_loading: Overlay visible, progress bar active, input receives focus but results empty during indexing
states.opened_ready: Overlay visible, file index complete, results populated on input
states.filtering: User typing, 150ms debounce active, results updating
